# vcell-hy3s is a Fortran project, so it is built with GCC. Clang has no
# Fortran compiler, and gfortran's runtime is built against libstdc++, so the
# libc++ toolchain the ODE solver repo uses is not an option here either.
#
# Only libcurl comes from Conan, and only when messaging is enabled. NetCDF is
# vendored: Conan Center publishes the C library alone, with no Fortran module
# and no netcdf-fortran recipe, and Hy3S does `USE netcdf`. See README.md.
[settings]
arch=x86_64
build_type=Release
compiler=gcc
compiler.version=13
compiler.libcxx=libstdc++11
compiler.cppstd=20
os=Linux

[conf]
# Required: conanfile.py's layout() only flattens the tree to build/generators
# when this is set. Without it, cmake_layout() emits build/Release/generators.
tools.cmake.cmaketoolchain:generator=Ninja

[options]
fPIC=True
shared=False
